comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Automatically obtained from new inland オリンピアのゼウス神殿, which could be entering by getting center lead of new legacy "Olympia the Land of Competitions". Gives another Add Ship Equipment effect but this item lets you anchor your ship really done, even at full speed, and it lasts 1 day. Might be useful for situation where you need a fast anchor.

Appearance-wise, it will force change your "Front Left" and "Front Right" deco ship slot with Celestial Globe Anchor installed in both slots.

Part of the new Memorial Album Ancient Olympic Games.
